title: Jesus Is the Way
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: Jesus is preparing a place for us, and he is also the way there. We don't have to muscle ourselves home.
exhortation: What a beautiful statement. We have the comfort of our future: Jesus is preparing a place for us. What a wonderful thing to imagine, that Jesus would be building something and preparing something for us. We know he has great and wonderful things in store for us.

And yet, like Thomas, we can fail to understand the way there. "Lord, how do we get there?" We need to remind ourselves of something. Often we're good at knowing that Jesus is our salvation, but we forget that Jesus is the way. We tend to thank God for our salvation and then put it on our own shoulders to get ourselves there, or to muscle ourselves through the day.

We need to remind ourselves that Jesus is also the way. He is with us along the way through the power of his Holy Spirit, and he will bring us home. He will bring us all the way to where we need to be.

So how do we depend on Jesus as we look to him? Through prayer, through confession and repentance, by reminding ourselves that he is with us, and by asking the Holy Spirit to fill us as we walk along the way. There are treacherous things in our path, but Jesus has conquered them all. So look to Jesus along the way, and he will bring us safely home.
prayer: Lord, we put our faith and our trust fully in your completed work. Draw our hearts and our eyes to you as we go out into our day. Help us remember that all the trappings and temptations of this day, whether comfort, security, money, wealth or pleasure, are short shadows of the joy we can experience in you. Far surpassing joy is found in you, Jesus.

So may we trust in your completed work. May we turn away from all other distractions and temptations and put our faith fully in you this morning, with our eyes fixed on you, Jesus. In Jesus' name, amen.
